Nani's film 'The Paradise' teaser released, showing intense action

The teaser for the upcoming film 'The Paradise', starring actor Nani, has been released. Nani appears in a rugged, intense avatar, portraying a tribal leader. The film, directed by Srikanth Odela, is described as a dark revenge drama and promises intense action. The teaser also features actor Raghav Juyal as a menacing antagonist, with the preview suggesting a significant clash between the two characters. 'The Paradise' is scheduled for a theatrical release on September 24, 2026.
